title: Yau's First Eigenvalue Conjecture for Minimal Hypersurfaces
exact_target: Is the first nonzero Laplace eigenvalue of every connected closed embedded minimal hypersurface in the unit sphere equal to its dimension?

sources.citation: A. Jimenez, C. Tapia Chinchay and D. Zhou, A lower bound for the first eigenvalue of a minimal hypersurface in the sphere, Rev. Mat. Iberoam. 42 (2026).
